import AlgebraicJacobian.Albanese.Genus0Terminal
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0VanishingRoute

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace ProbeR2b

open AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

-- Probe A: the datum produced by the vanishing route is TERMINAL.
noncomputable example
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    IsTerminal (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J :=
  JacobianData.isTerminal_of_pic0Subgroup_eq_bot _
    (fun T => pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton (pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton (h T) ▸ h T))

-- Probe A': same, cleanly.
noncomputable example
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    IsTerminal (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J :=
  JacobianData.isTerminal_of_pic0Subgroup_eq_bot _
    (fun T => pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton (h T))

-- Probe B: it is directly terminal, since it IS Over.mk (id).
noncomputable example
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)) :
    IsTerminal (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J :=
  Over.mkIdTerminal

-- Probe C: the S11 uniqueness clause, UNCONDITIONALLY on any datum-producing route.
example
    (h : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T))
    (hs : Surjective C.hom) (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : C ⟶ A)
    (hex : ∃ g : (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J ⟶ A,
      f = (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).ofCurve P ≫ g) :
    ∃! g : (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).J ⟶ A,
      f = (jacobianData_of_subsingleton C h).ofCurve P ≫ g :=
  JacobianData.existsUnique_ofCurve_comp_of_pic0Subgroup_eq_bot _
    (fun T => pic0Subgroup_eq_bot_of_subsingleton (h T)) hs P f hex

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

end ProbeR2b
